en.headline: Against Child Abuse records 216 suspected cases involving 241 children last year
en.dek: Children aged three to five formed the largest group among the cases, with more than 70 per cent of alleged abusers being family members, the organisation said.
body: Against Child Abuse said it received 1,136 hotline reports and consultations in the 2025/26 financial year, of which 216 were suspected child abuse cases involving 241 children.

Children aged three to five accounted for the largest share, with 65 victims, followed by 42 aged six to eight. The organisation said more than 70 per cent of the 265 alleged abusers were family members, mainly parents.

Physical abuse made up about half the suspected cases, followed by neglect at 22 per cent, psychological abuse at 13 per cent and sexual abuse at 8 per cent. Against Child Abuse noted that neglect, sexual abuse and psychological abuse may be under-reported because they are harder to identify.

Director Lou Siu-kwan said many parents face heavy work and life pressure and lack family support or parenting knowledge, which can lead them to vent negative emotions on children. The group also raised concern about a rise in cases involving online grooming through smartphones and the internet.

The organisation recommended introducing an offence of causing or allowing a child or vulnerable adult to die or suffer serious harm, and called on online platforms to detect and remove child abuse material promptly.

zh.headline: 防止虐待兒童會上年度錄得216宗懷疑虐兒個案涉241名兒童
zh.dek: 3至5歲兒童佔最多，超過七成懷疑施虐者為家庭成員，機構指家長壓力大及缺乏管教支援是主因。
body: 防止虐待兒童會表示，2025/26年度共接獲1136宗熱線舉報及諮詢，當中216宗屬懷疑虐兒個案，涉241名兒童。
年齡分佈以3至5歲最多，有65人，其次為6至8歲的42人。機構指265名懷疑施虐者中超過七成為家庭成員，主要是父母。
身體虐待佔懷疑個案約一半，其次為疏忽照顧22%、心理虐待13%及性侵犯8%。會方指出，疏忽照顧、性侵犯及心理虐待或因較難辨識而舉報不足。
總幹事婁小君說，不少家長面對工作與生活雙重壓力，缺乏家人支援及育兒知識，容易將負面情緒發洩在子女身上。機構亦關注透過智能電話及互聯網誘識兒童的個案上升。
會方建議儘早訂立「導致或任由兒童或易受傷害成年人死亡或受嚴重傷害」罪行，並要求網上平台及時偵測及移除兒童侵犯材料。
